episode_in_one_sentence: People are giving agents concrete jobs to finish, from a spare-phone focus monitor and a lobster retailer's ad campaign to instrument scheduling and editable materials-simulation recipes.

listener_notes.note: The weight edit is an excellent hook, but 'a sixteen-thousandth' does not equal the source's 0.016 percent. Views also became a count of people.
The spare-phone screenshot loop is memorable and easy to retell. Berman's broad build-your-own-software conclusion overlaps the later Muse pitch.
The weight story stacks benchmark names and adjacent experiments before explaining the repetition-loop mechanism. The Maine Lobster numbers need the vendor case-study attribution.
Four stories make the good sailing, AirPods and family-globe pieces feel like a list. The extra Backrooms game is expendable.
Three full picks become five when two quick ones arrive. The closing repo pair dilutes the CPU model, decision-card loop and compact geometry language.
Four launches are too many for this slot. Splice also forces pricing and export qualifications into an otherwise opportunity-first desk.
The fourth creator recipe repeats the agent-plus-Blender pattern rather than adding a new listening turn.
AutoDNA is strong, but five science stories before the lab pick crowd out the recurring beat. The NMR item does not get a distinct experiment.
DefectSkills is the right skeptical-scientist pick. Keep its researcher decisions, worked calculation counts and brief intervention record together.
Five experiments repeat earlier instructions in rapid succession. Three new playful applications would make a better final impression.

after_evidence.hook: The 79-word opening names Astra's weight edit and asks what actually changed. It runs about 31 seconds and teases AutoDNA without a theme list.
after_evidence.audience_fit: Each regular desk has three picks. Fourteen of the 24 substantive items are consumer, creator, small-business, indie or personal-productivity stories.
after_evidence.inspiration: Distinct sparks include a spare-phone habit gadget, personal editing skills, a sailing sandbox, a processor leaderboard and an editable geometry program.
after_evidence.science_value: Research leads with AutoDNA, then route-aware NMR, then the exact named 'Share this with your lab' beat on the DefectSkills selection in science.json.lab_pick.
after_evidence.caution_budget: The reality check is the final content within Research and contains only inter-agent influence, the DOJ task force and Education's proposed priorities. DefectSkills interventions remain brief method-reporting detail inside that example, without warning language or a second telling.
after_evidence.specificity: Every desk retains named builders or products and source-grounded results, including nine-cent phone monitoring, the sailing costs, the 64-gigabyte model and the 90-atom DefectSkills example.
after_evidence.non_redundancy: Berman, Backrooms, cinecode, terminal-mac, Splice, Morrow and the extra science pile are cut. Related creative stories retain different jobs: learn editing taste, rough-cut footage, fix a camera path, or generate brand assets.
after_evidence.clarity_for_ear: Final lint reports no sentences over 30 words and an average of 10.2 words. NMR is spoken in full, kernel detail is translated, and dense tool inventories are shortened.
after_evidence.momentum: Six regular desks run about two to two-and-a-quarter minutes each. Aaron earns the longer final desk, with a discovery turn, a named recurring beat and the final reality check.
after_evidence.voice_distinctness: Marcus talks in bookmarks and creator taste, Priya uses quick turns from mathematics to lobster, Sam enjoys the boat race and family build, and Aaron tells the science deliberately.
after_evidence.flow_and_handoffs: All seven _segment tails explicitly return to Jordan. Cues include quick pivots, two pre-sting acknowledgments and callbacks to the opening and preceding desk.
after_evidence.accuracy: The false weight fraction and unique-viewer implication are removed. AutoDNA uses hardware maintenance rather than reagent refills alone, Maine Lobster is explicitly a Perplexity case study, and the watch beat makes no promised release-date claim.
after_evidence.tts_readiness: Final lint reports zero symbol warnings. Versions are spoken, four-kay replaces 4K, sand three dee replaces the ambiguous repo token, and Vasp uses word casing rather than an all-caps letter cue.
after_evidence.close: Two opportunity watch signals come from X emerging_signals. Jordan then gives exactly three playful applications, animation, a moving-joint toy and a shared gift tracker, and signs off at the AI Brief Hub.

summary_for_producer: The draft had strong material but several desks became four- or five-story lists, Research was overcrowded, and the close repeated five instructions. The edit keeps three stories per regular desk, gives Research two science leads followed by the exact DefectSkills lab pick, and ends that desk with three distinct oversight and policy items. Maine Lobster is explicitly a Perplexity case study, Splice is cut rather than resolving its export conflict in audio, and the watch beat uses real emerging_signals without invented timing. After the single targeted second round, lint has zero errors and zero warnings; the episode runs about 19 minutes rather than adding padding to reach the preferred length. Next week, follow open-model coding opportunities and DeepMind's science releases while looking for another lab's reusable scientific workflow.
